questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion with the subordinate clause to emphasise the result of a hypothetical situation?
options: Although she had little experience, she was able to complete the project on time.
Had she not studied so hard, she would not have passed the exam.
If it were possible to travel in time, many historical events would have changed.
Only when the data were analysed thoroughly did the team realise the error in their calculations.
questions.answer: Had she not studied so hard, she would not have passed the exam.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a cleft construction to highlight the subject of a complex clause?
options: It was not until the last minute that the decision was made.
The issue that caused the delay was the lack of funding.
The fact that she had been working for years surprised everyone.
What surprised me most was that he had never mentioned his plans.
questions.answer: The fact that she had been working for years surprised everyone.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a third conditional with the subjunctive mood to express regret over past actions?
options: If I had known the rules better, I would have avoided the mistake.
She wishes she could have met him again, but it’s too late now.
He would have helped if he had been asked, but he didn’t think it was important.
They regret that they didn’t buy the house sooner, but they’re not sorry now.
questions.answer: If I had known the rules better, I would have avoided the mistake.

questions.question: Which sentence uses ellipsis to omit redundant information while maintaining formal clarity?
options: The report, which was submitted on time, was well-received by the board.
Having finished the task, she went home immediately.
The project, *it was completed ahead of schedule*, was praised for its efficiency.
She didn’t attend the meeting, *as she had planned to*.
questions.answer: The project, *it was completed ahead of schedule*, was praised for its efficiency.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the use of a formal register with a passive construction and a nuanced choice of verb form?
options: The proposal was rejected due to insufficient evidence provided by the committee.
The committee had already decided against the proposal before the evidence was reviewed.
The evidence was insufficient; hence, the proposal was not approved.
The committee’s decision was influenced by the lack of thorough analysis.
questions.answer: The proposal was rejected due to insufficient evidence provided by the committee.
